reusableIssueFamilies.fix: Retain source-only and target-only IDs. Projection excludes incomplete IDs and blocks ambiguous same-name source collisions; tests cover both directions.
reusableIssueFamilies.evidence: Repository collect_search_pairs previously intersected locale ID sets; synthetic cross-ID regression reproduces the unsafe omission. No claim that a specific live guide was mistranslated.

heldOutFindings: English indexed cheat sheets contain serialized stat-guide/stats= configurations and talent-import controls, which are not translation prose.
Some indexed guide variants contain unfinished season placeholders; these are upstream content, not MEZU output defects.
Localized Wowhead guide variants can contain English prose mixed with translated spell names and English plural suffixes; only English-source URLs were added to the regression corpus.
